summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-10 reverse share split effective October 23, 2026, plus a redesignation of ordinary shares into Class A (one vote) and Class B (ten votes) shares, following shareholder approval at a September 14, 2026 EGM. Post-split Class A shares trade on NYSE American under CHOW from October 26, 2026, new CUSIP G2124J116. Authorized capital rose to US$100 billion. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch for low-float volatility and any future Class B control implications.
